title: Hours and minutes
statementMd:
Show each flight id (first 5 ids only) with its duration as hours, rounded to 1 decimal.

Expected columns: `id`, `hours`.

Tables: `airlines`, `airports`, `flights`, `bookings`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT id, ROUND(duration_min / 60.0, 1) AS hours FROM flights WHERE id <= 5;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
